basic_info.description: This rare two-residence Bernal Heights property consists of two separate homes on one lot, both with street facing facades, the main residence at 223 Bocana Street and the guest home at 18 Bennington Street. The main home is a two bedroom + den, two level residence with solid wood floors, a renovated kitchen and one bathroom. The homes tall ceilings and spacious rooms are flooded in light and the rear media room just off the kitchen giving multiple areas to enjoy the home. The two bedrooms are on the upper level of the home and offer views to the West and East.  The large one car garage provides interior access to the main residence and has ample storage space, laundry facilities and an entry way to the rear patio and guest house. The one bedroom, one bathroom guest house has a newly renovated kitchen with custom cabinetry, heath ceramic tile floors and south facing windows for maximum light. The attached patio terrace is accessible from both the kitchen living room and expands the livable space of the home. This truly special and unique offering sits just steps from Cortland Ave and Bernal Heights Park and all that the area has to offer.
